question: How do I support someone who is grieving?
intent: Help a grieving person with sensitivity
why_this_adds_coverage: Adds supporter-facing grief content. It can include what to say, what not to say, and when to encourage extra help.

source_refs.title: Grief
source_refs.note: Would support grief support and coping context.

notes: Mention crisis support if the grieving person talks about wanting to die.

question: Why do I feel guilty after a loved one dies?
why_this_adds_coverage: Adds coverage for guilt and regret, common but distinct grief experiences. Important for users stuck in self-blame.

source_refs.title: Grief
source_refs.note: Would support grief reactions and coping with loss.

notes: Escalate if guilt includes self-punishment or suicidal thinking.

question: When does grief become something I should get help for?
intent: Identify when grief may need professional support
why_this_adds_coverage: Addresses the boundary between painful grief and impairing or dangerous grief symptoms. Useful for trust-safe triage.

source_refs.title: Grief
source_refs.note: Would support professional help-seeking when grief is persistent or impairing.

notes: Avoid diagnosing prolonged grief disorder; mention professional evaluation.

question: Why do I feel like I am not good enough?
why_this_adds_coverage: A core self-worth question with broad relevance across anxiety, depression, trauma, and relationships. Needs compassionate, non-diagnostic framing.

source_refs.title: Building Your Resilience
source_refs.note: Would support resilience, self-perception, and coping context.

notes: Include self-harm escalation if worthlessness includes wanting not to live.

question: How can I stop comparing myself to everyone else?
intent: Reduce harmful comparison and improve self-esteem
why_this_adds_coverage: Adds a modern self-worth concern tied to social pressure and identity. Distinct from general confidence questions.

source_refs.title: Building Your Resilience
source_refs.note: Would support coping, perspective, and resilience-building strategies.

notes: Could later link to social media and teen identity content.

question: Why do compliments make me uncomfortable?
why_this_adds_coverage: Adds a subtle self-worth pattern not covered by broad low-esteem questions. It can explore shame, mistrust, and self-image carefully.

source_refs.title: Relationships
source_refs.note: Would support interpersonal and self-perception context.

notes: Avoid overinterpreting discomfort as trauma or pathology.

question: How do I figure out who I am outside of what other people expect?
intent: Explore identity separate from external pressure

source_refs.title: Building Your Resilience

question: Can low self-esteem affect relationships?

source_refs.title: Relationships
